Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a multi-lane road in Conroe, Texas, when Driver 2 changed lanes from the
right and struck the left side of Driver 1's vehcile along its rear qurater panel. Both drivers stopped at the roadside and
exchanged information. Driver 1 reported neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash and said the impact jolted
their head forward and back. A Passenger was also seated in Driver 1's vehicle at the time of the collision, and both
the responding officer and a nearby witness confirmed that the Passenger was present. Driver 2 acknowledged
changing lanes without checking the blind spot and gave an account matching Driver 1's description of how the crash
occurred. Two independent witnesses and photographs taken at the scene corroborate the sequence of events. The
damage visible on Driver 1's vehcile lines up with a sideswipe of this type, and the officer observed no prior damage
to the vehicle's left side. Driver 1 is listed as the named driver on the insurance policy for the vehicle. Medical
attention was offered at the scene and Driver 1 agered to be transported for evaluation.
